serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Cashier.ArmR.scanner
She’s at the cash register today.
There are no wasted movements in her work.
How is no one else noticing it? Maybe I went crazy and it’s all in my head…
It’s very busy today so I won’t have an opportunity to talk with her. 
Yet again, I just wasted time without getting any closer to my goal.
Right now, the only thing that comes to my mind is confronting her about my suspicions and hope for the best. 
Maybe someone else would have an idea how to approach this.
I should ask around for some tips.
Do I need to buy something? 
I’m already here so it wouldn’t hurt to look around.
